nom: Mario Badescu Glycolic Grapefruit Cleansing Lotion

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin most often report the product controls excess oil and clears breakouts without over-drying, especially with regular use, though a few oily-skin reviewers also describe burning, hives, or a dry, flaky reaction after the first uses.
segments.dry: A couple of reviewers with dry or normal-to-dry skin report the product ended persistent flaking and dullness, but other reviewers and even one reviewer's own advice suggest this alcohol-based formula is more likely to sting and dry out drier skin than the brand's alcohol-free glycolic toner.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin are split: several describe burning, stinging, dryness, or redness severe enough that they returned the product, while others report smaller pores, no more dry patches or excess oil, and clearer skin, often after cutting back to every other night.
segments.sensitive: Numerous reviewers, including several who say they don't personally have sensitive skin, warn that the product is too harsh for sensitive skin and can cause burning or irritation; a couple of self-described sensitive-skin reviewers who limited use to once or twice a week still report toning and acne/scar-fading benefits.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin (not oily or dry) reports it burned and left an unusual shine, while another with normal-to-dry skin reports it ended persistent flaking and dullness.
segments.mature: The few reviewers in their 40s who mention their age report softer forehead lines and less dullness or scaliness after a few weeks of consistent use.

concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including several who identify as oily or acne-prone, report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and fading acne scars after weeks of consistent use; but a notable number, including some who say they don't normally react to products, report the opposite — new breakouts, hives, or painful bumps within the first few uses.
concerns.dehydration: Reports split largely along the reviewer's underlying skin type: several with oily skin say the formula doesn't dry them out and even hydrates thanks to its aloe vera, while reviewers with combination, normal, or drier skin more often report dryness, flaking, or a drying effect that can last for days after each use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers describe persistent redness, rawness, or red bumps during use, in some cases lasting the entire time they used the product; one reviewer, in contrast, reports the redness around her remaining blemishes faded with continued use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically attributes the alcohol in the formula to breaking down the skin barrier, saying this let her skin problems return faster once she stopped using it.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading dark spots or old acne scars within one to several weeks of use; no reviewer in this set reports spots or scarring getting worse.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin frequently report the product controls excess oil without over-drying; one reviewer, however, says the product itself felt oily and left her skin oilier than she wanted.
concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers in their 40s report visibly softer forehead lines and less dullness after a few weeks of use, though one notes her wrinkles and pores did not disappear, just looked less pronounced.

aspects.libelle: Noticeable stinging or tingling on application
Contains alcohol, harsher than plain glycolic toner
Often needs a moisturizer after to offset dryness
Large bottle lasts a long time

extraits.texte: I am 28 and I have combination skin, it burned pretty badly and left my sling feeling irritated,itchy and changed the texture of my skin. I would recommend testing before buying.

I bought this product in conjunction with the Enzyme Cleansing gel (in love). However, this toner is extremely harsh on the skin. I have very oily skin in the T-Zone but normal skin on the perimeter of my face. I have mild acne and very clogged pores due to my oil production and acne scars (because I pop my pimples). I used this product after handwashing (no tools) and had an immediate stinging sensation. I tried to attribute it to it "working" but too often we equate stinging and tingling with working but it is actually your skin telling you to STOP! CEASE! DESIST! I tried to use it again the next day but it started to burn my skin, I had to immediately wash it off with cool water. My chin and skin around my nose was raw and red . I tried to moisturize it because it was super dry, but because of the trauma even my mild organic coconut oil moisturizer burned. I returned this product immediately. Still looking for the "right" toner. I purchased Origins Zero-Oil no burning and it has controlled my oil throughout the day. We will see.

I do not have sensitive skin and usually use a scrub to exfoliate my skin. I wanted to try a chemical exfoliator and found this in the ulta store. I've given it 2 tries with the same result. Each use made parts of my face feel like rubbing alcohol on an open cut. I have no cuts or acne. Even 30 min after using and moisturizing, my face feels burnt and sensitive. I have normal skin, not oily or dry, but after using this my skin had a horrible shine to it as well.

I was very disappointed in this product. It was very harsh on my combination skin and worked well at first but my skin began to go back to the way it used to be in about a month. I was very disgusted after reading the ingredients that a "Prestige" brand would use rubbing alcohol (went by another name) as one of their ingredients. That breaks skin barriers down and may kill bacteria but by taking that barrier, it also comes back faster. I returned it after noticing that.

I use this cleansing lotion to help dry/disenfect my pimples, as well as help clear old acne scars, and exfoliate my skin. Of course since I have sensitive skin, I can only use this toner about 1-2 times a week; even if you don't have sensitive skin, this should probably be limited to 2-3 times a week considering how strong glycolic acid is. But other than that, I use this stuff religiously. It's awesome for toning the skin, exfolating, and helping get rid of acne/acne scars/dark spots.

I am not one to review beauty products because I buy so many of them and am rarely impressed. But this toner is absolutely amazing. I have naturally good skin with few issues but since turning 40 I have a few wrinkles on my forehead, the 11 lines that I cannot stand. Also I have some annoying dry patches on my forehead above my eyebrows and side of nose. After using this toner for 2 weeks, the dry patches are totally gone and the forehead wrinkles are less prominent. Must be the glycolic acid. I am so impressed. My pores are smaller too and my skin looks radiant I bought the Mario Badescu anti aging starter kit today. I am excited to see how the other products work. I highly recommend this stuff. I should mention I have VERY oily skin so maybe that is why I can use this toner twice a day without drying out my skin like others have said it does.

I have very oily skin with large pores. My skin has developed a rougher texture now that I'm in my 30s and I have closed comedones (tiny whiteheads that don't go away like acne) near my eyes. I've been using this toner for 2 weeks and noticed my skin looks much clearer and it's slowly starting to dissolve the comedones. I experienced a little bit of itching when I first applied it, but that went away quickly. I definitely didn't experience the burning that other reviewers have mentioned.
